name: Giantkin
description:
In the oldest accounts, the Giants did not merely live upon the land — they shaped it, hollowed it, and some say merged with it at the last, becoming the mountains themselves. The Giantkin are all that remains of them in the world of the living: tall, broad, and built to endure in ways that make ordinary hardship feel like a light breeze. Their past is beyond recovery. The peaks persist, but they do not speak.

Height: 7-9' | Weight: 275-700 lbs | Average Lifespan: 200 years | Speed: 30
